mail.label: Mail
mail.description: Internal mailbox: personal and group mailboxes, distribution lists. No message leaves the system.
mail.address.invalid: The address needs a part before the @ and a domain.
mail.address.too_long: The part before the @ may be at most :max characters long.
mail.address.local: The part before the @ may only contain lower-case letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore, and must start and end with a letter or digit.
mail.address.domain: The domain ":domain" is not allowed. Allowed: :allowed.
mail.address.taken: The address :address is already taken or reserved for another mailbox.
settings.mail.domain.label: Default domain
settings.mail.domain.hint: Domain of new mailboxes, e.g. ignis.ef.
settings.mail.address_pattern.label: Address pattern
settings.mail.address_pattern.hint: How the address of a new personal mailbox is built from the name.
settings.mail.allowed_domains.label: Further allowed domains
settings.mail.allowed_domains.hint: Domains the administration may assign in addition.
settings.mail.send_cooldown.label: Send pause per mailbox (seconds)
settings.mail.send_cooldown.hint: Minimum gap between two mails of one mailbox (0 to 3600 seconds).
mail.notification.title: New mail from :name
mail.body.too_large: The text is too large (at most :max KB).
mail.body.too_deep: The text is nested too deeply (too many quotes or lists inside each other).
mail.send.too_many_raw: Too many recipients (at most :max in To, CC and BCC together).
mail.send.too_many_resolved: Too many recipients after resolving the lists (at most :max).
mail.send.undeliverable: No recipient can receive mail. Unknown, inactive or locked and therefore not deliverable: :addresses.
mail.send.empty_lists: No recipient can receive mail: the lists have no active members.
mail.send.list_managers_only: Only list managers may write to the list :address.
mail.send.already_sent: This mail has already been sent.
mail.send.cooldown: Please wait :seconds more second before the next mail.|Please wait :seconds more seconds before the next mail.
mail.content.link: Links must start with http://, https:// or mailto:.
mail.content.image: Images are only allowed as rank badges.
mail.compose.subject: Subject
mail.editor.label: Mail text
mail.editor.link_invalid: Only http://, https:// or mailto: is allowed.
mail.signature.title: Signature
mail.signature.intro: The signature is placed below the text when composing. Placeholders are filled from the writer's profile; empty lines are dropped.
mail.signature.default_hint: No own signature yet: the editor shows the default signature.
mail.signature.none_hint: Saving it empty means: no signature.
mail.signature.invalid: The signature is not a valid document.
mail.signature.too_large: The signature is too long (at most :max KB).
mail.signature.paragraphs_only: The signature contains something other than paragraphs.
mail.signature.not_allowed: The signature contains content that is not allowed.
mail.signature.marks: The signature contains formatting that is not allowed.
mail.signature.var.absender.name: Name with title
mail.signature.var.postfach.name: Mailbox
mail.drafts_hint: Drafts not changed for :days days are deleted.
mail.state.none: No mailbox yet. It is created with your personnel record.
mail.pane.label: Reading pane
mail.pane.empty: Choose a mail from the list.
mail.pane.broken: The text of this mail cannot be shown.
mail.action.delete_confirm: Delete your copy of this mail for good? The other participants keep theirs.
mail.action.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
mail.compose.offline: No connection. The draft is saved again with the next change.
mail.attachment.hint: Images, PDF or text; at most :file MB per file, :mail MB per mail.
mail.attachment.too_large: The file is too large (at most :max MB per attachment).
mail.attachment.type: This file type is not allowed (only images, PDF or text).
mail.attachment.mail_full: The attachments of this mail would be too large together (at most :max MB per mail).
mail.attachment.quota: The mailbox has no room left for attachments (at most :max MB per mailbox).
mail.attachment.sent: The mail has already been sent; its attachments can no longer change.
mail.lists.title: Distribution lists
mail.lists.intro: Static lists have fixed members, dynamic ones a rule (any criterion matches). Lists never contain lists.
mail.lists.name: Name
mail.lists.members_hint: Only active, unlocked mailboxes can join; current members stay.
mail.lists.rule_hint: Mail goes to every deliverable mailbox matching at least one chosen criterion (role: any role of the account).
mail.lists.rule_required: A dynamic list needs at least one role, rank, qualification or specialty.
mail.admin.title: Mailboxes
mail.admin.intro: Mailboxes are managed here, not their content: these pages show no mail.
mail.admin.group_intro: A group mailbox has members instead of an account; another administrator adds them afterwards.
mail.admin.name: Name
mail.admin.address_hint: The old address stays reserved for this mailbox and still delivers.
mail.admin.own_hint: This is your own mailbox. Another administrator changes its address, lock and account.
mail.admin.own_mailbox: Another administrator changes your own mailbox.
mail.admin.members_hint: Members read the mailbox. Nobody adds or removes themselves: somebody else does that.
mail.admin.member_not_oneself: Nobody adds or removes themselves: another administrator does that.
mail.admin.member_missing: This account is not a member.
mail.admin.member_removed: :name no longer reads the group mailbox.
mail.admin.lock_hint: A locked mailbox receives nothing and cannot be opened. Only the administration lifts the lock.
mail.admin.unlocked_inactive: The lock of :address is lifted. The mailbox stays inactive because its record left the service or was deleted.
mail.admin.account_hint: Only an active account linked to the record and without a mailbox. The previous account is notified.
mail.admin.account_assigned: The mailbox now belongs to the chosen account.
mail.admin.account_released: The mailbox no longer belongs to an account.
mail.admin.account_not_eligible: This account is not linked to the record, not active or already has a mailbox.
mail.admin.not_to_oneself: A mailbox cannot be assigned to your own account.
mail.admin.group_has_no_account: A group mailbox has no account; its readers are its members.
mail.admin.moved_message: The mailbox :address no longer belongs to your account. The mailbox administration answers questions about it.
mail.admin.group_created: Group mailbox created. It still needs members.
mail.settings.title: Mail settings
mail.settings.intro: Domain and pattern apply to new mailboxes; existing addresses stay.
mail.settings.domain_locked: Only accounts that may choose mail domains change the default domain.
mail.settings.allowed_hint: Separated by commas or spaces, e.g. lspd.de, rettung.test.
mail.settings.signature_hint: Applies to every mailbox without its own signature. Placeholders take the details of the writer.
mail.settings.invalid_domain: The default domain is not a valid domain (e.g. ignis.ef).
mail.admin.account_release_confirm: Really release :address from its account? The account is notified.
mail.admin.release_blocked: The account is still linked to the personnel record and would get the mailbox back at once (or another linked account would). Unlink the record in the user administration first, or lock the mailbox.
